description: This Java class implements the ScriptHelper interface, providing utility methods for script execution, entity retrieval, service invocation, and logging within the OFBiz framework. It manages interactions with entities, services, and scripting context, facilitating script-based automation and data handling.

classes.name: ScriptHelperImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ScriptHelper interface, providing methods for script context management, entity operations, service calls, and logging within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createServiceMap
methods.description: Constructs a validated service input map based on the service name and input parameters, handling exceptions related to service definition retrieval.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets error messages and response codes in the scripting context, differentiating between event and service contexts.

methods.name: evalString
methods.description: Expands variables or expressions within a string using the scripting context.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Sets failure messages and response codes in the scripting context, differentiating between event and service contexts.

methods.name: findList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entity records matching specified fields, with error handling.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity record by primary key, with optional fields and arguments.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message with script context information.

methods.name: logInfo
methods.description: Logs an informational message with script context information.

methods.name: logWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with script context information.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a valid entity value object, optionally with specified fields.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with optional transaction and user login handling, returning the result map.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sets success status in the scripting context, with optional message.
